BiblicalUsage: Daniel stands trembling when the angel speaks to him, and all the people sit in the street of the house of God trembling, because of the matter and for the great rain. The word is the shuddering itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe trembling before God is the right posture, and Daniel stood trembling when the words came to him.
